​One off many situations happend during my pregnancy. I needed vaccinations which are only available at 3 PM. ​This wasn't an isolated incident. There were constant issues with prescriptions; despite receiving texts saying they were ready, the pharmacy next door never received them on time, forcing me to go back and forth repeatedly. Once, a doctor forgot to log my repeat prescription in the system, forcing me to restart the entire process and waste more annual leave.
​They have zero respect for patients' time or the fact that people have to take time off work. Everything is overcomplicated and requires multiple attempts to resolve. I moved to a different GP a year ago, and it restored my faith in the NHS and the system. I am not a confrontational person by nature, but I cannot stay silent about White House Surgery.
